messages.subject: ggplot2-dev
parts:
Hi all,

Just a quick heads up that I've created a new ggplot2 development
mailing list - http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2-dev. The idea
is to move all the development conversations I'm currently having with
various individuals into a public forum so that everyone can
participate, and any one who is interested can learn more about
ggplot2 development.

Have also been working through all the outstanding bugs in
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues - they should all now be
categorised into various milestones, or closed if they've already been
fixed.

Regards,

Hadley
